Subject: ONE complete connected sheet of dead whale mesentery with fatty organic folds, R3 environment landmark 16 hero units wide. A loosely drooping horizontal fan of semitranslucent ochre-beige mesenteric web connecting several soft rounded muted burgundy fat lobules, gently scalloped edge and a few short attached stringlike tissues. It reads as flexible connective organ tissue, not bone, teeth, coral, intestinal tube or baleen. Muted golden ochre, earthy reddish brown, shadow olive. Shallow uneven top, decorative midground not a ready platform. No acidic liquid, no yellow pool. Fully contained one coherent draped piece.
